native_clipboard_proof.reason: Local named station creation denied; generated existing station refused. No local clipboard API was called.

limits: Modeled native boundaries and offscreen recording tests do not prove the Windows clipboard backend.
Real desktop handle inheritance/join/cleanup is verified under Python 3.14/3.13, with no clipboard API; this is not station or clipboard isolation proof.
The hosted job must verify fresh private station creation, real native CF_UNICODETEXT, exact scopes, hashes and all cleanup before #111 closes.
Noninteractive station timings will not establish interactive clipboard-manager contention, settled frames or end-to-end input latency.
Initial exploratory refusals are recorded from terminal outcomes, before Qt/clipboard access; no native clipboard success data exists locally.
Two earlier full runs were deliberately stopped by verified owned PID/parent/command with zero direct children; neither is a Qt incident.
